about.storyP1: S3K Studios was founded in 2015 with a simple mission: to create games that inspire, challenge, and bring joy to players around the world. Our team of passionate developers, artists, and storytellers work tirelessly to push the boundaries of what's possible in interactive entertainment.
about.storyP2: From our humble beginnings in a small garage to our current state-of-the-art studio, we've always stayed true to our core values of creativity, innovation, and player-first design. With each game we release, we strive to deliver unforgettable experiences that resonate with gamers of all ages and backgrounds.
about.heroDesc: S3K Studios: The Players Behind the Pixels. We are a collective of dreamers, coders, and artists crafting immersive worlds where you are the hero.

about.timeline1Desc: Three friends, one coffee machine, and zero budget. We built our first mobile games, Splitomic and 777 Pinball.

about.playerCentricDesc: We create games with our players' enjoyment as the top priority.
